what.title: What Eco-One™ is
what.body: Eco-One™ is an additive mixed into compatible plastics so they can biodegrade more readily where microbes are active. It is not permission to litter, and it does not replace sound waste handling and recycling.

steps.0: Eco-One™ is built into compatible plastic parts during manufacturing.
steps.1: In active biological environments, the material can break down faster than conventional plastics — depending on shape and how the product is disposed of.
steps.2: Rules and certifications differ by country and use case; we will help you apply the right documents to your project.

value.title: Why teams ask for it
value.body: Washrooms need a credible materials story. Eco-One™ helps you talk about end-of-life for compatible plastics — alongside reducing waste and recycling where possible.

claims.title: Claims and documentation
claims.body: Environmental performance depends on the product, local rules, and how waste is handled. Rely on our official documents for any public statement and keep wording accurate.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: No. It is one tool in a broader materials strategy. Recycling where feasible remains important.
faq.q2: Does every ëkcos product include Eco-One™?
faq.a2: It depends on the product — each product page shows what applies.
faq.a3: Browse the product range or contact us for paperwork tailored to your rollout.

reference.disclaimer: Environmental rules and disposal options differ by country — confirm what applies to your site and product.

methodology.title: How the test was performed
methodology.body: Ekcos screen with 1% Eco-One additive was tested alongside samples without additive and cellulose as positive control, per ASTM D5511-02 and ISO 15985:2014 under anaerobic conditions at 50°C. Biogas was measured by chromatography; the conclusion confirms substantially higher biodegradation versus the sample without additive.

xcrenPuck.name: xcrën puck
xcrenPuck.short: NON-PARA puck urinal screen for odor control and drainage protection.
xcrenPuck.long: xcrën is a NON-PARA puck urinal screen designed for effective odor control and drainage protection. Unlike traditional PARA-based products, it is free from paradichlorobenzene (PARA), a compound classified as possibly carcinogenic by the WHO. Its unique X-shaped design prevents solids and debris from clogging the drainage system while ensuring a clean and fresh fragrance release after each use for up to 30 days.
